arxiv-2106-12138.title: Statistical Rendering for Visualization of Red Sea Eddy Simulation Data
arxiv-2106-12138.creator: Tushar Athawale, Alireza Entezari, Senior Member, IEEE, Bei Wang, and Chris R. Johnson, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2106-12138.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Tushar Athawale, Alireza Entezari, Senior Member, IEEE, Bei Wang, and Chris R. Johnson, Fellow, IEEE. Analyzing the effects of ocean eddies is important in oceanology for gaining insights into transport of energy and biogeochemical particles. We present an application of statistical visualization algorithms for the analysis of the Red Sea eddy simulation ensemble. Specifically, we demonstrate the applications of statistical volume rendering and statistical Morse complex summary maps to a velocity magnitude field for studying the eddy positions in the flow dataset.

arxiv-2111-13623.title: Entropic Gravity and Cosmology in Kaniadakis Statistics
arxiv-2111-13623.description: Abstract By using the Kaniadakis statistics, we discuss the modifications of Newtonian gravity and radial velocity profile in the light of Verlinde’s formalism for gravitational entropy. After considering the implications of κ \kappa -statistics on the gravitational potential, it is shown that an accelerated universe may be obtained by considering the Friedmann first equation in this non- extensive statistics. arxiv-2304-12888.title: Out-of-distribution Evidence-aware Fake News Detection via Dual Adversarial Debiasing
arxiv-2304-12888.creator: Qiang Liu, Junfei Wu, Shu Wu, Liang Wang
arxiv-2304-12888.description: Abstract Evidence-aware fake news detection aims to conduct reasoning between news and evidences, which are retrieved based on news content, to find uniformity or inconsistency. However, we find evidence-aware detection models suffer from biases, i.e., spurious correlations between news/evidence contents and true/fake news labels, and are hard to be generalized to Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) situations.

arxiv-2504-13760.title: Realizing string breaking dynamics in a ℤ 2 \mathds{Z}_{2} lattice gauge theory on quantum hardware
arxiv-2504-13760.creator: Constantia Alexandrou, Andreas Athenodorou, Kostas Blekos, Georgios Polykratis, Stefan Kühn
arxiv-2504-13760.description: Abstract We investigate static and dynamical aspects of string breaking in a ℤ 2 \mathds{Z}_{2} lattice gauge theory coupled to Kogut-Susskind staggered fermions. Using Tensor Network simulations, we demonstrate that the static potential as well as the site-resolved configuration of the matter sites and gauge links allows us to identify the regimes in which string breaking occurs.

arxiv-2508-16099.creator: Tian Le, Zhuokai Xu, Jinjin Liu, Ruiya Zhan, Zhiwei Wang, Xiao Lin
arxiv-2508-16099.description: Abstract Superconducting chiral domains associated with a time-reversal symmetry-breaking order parameter have garnered significant attention in Kagome systems. In this work, we demonstrate both the intrinsic direct-current and alternating-current Josephson effects in the nanoplates of the vanadium-based Kagome material CsV 3 Sb 5 , as evidenced by Fraunhofer-like patterns and Shapiro steps.
